fusions.name: Split Tongue
fusions.desc: Spits venom that deals 5 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 70% of that, with a 25% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Takes Both Roads
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles of you takes 12 poison damage and becomes [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Both Ways at Once
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Second Prong
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
